profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Software Infrastructure developments
Post-silicon validation frameworks design
Automation structure supports multi platforms
Customized ARMv8 64-bit architecture SoCs
High-speed Connectivity/Transport protocols

positions.title: Senior Staff Validation Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected the core post-silicon infrastructure and validation frameworks for Ampere’s 64-bit ARM server processors.
- Engineered automated testing workflows, integrating test compilation, system-under-test (SUT) configuration, and hardware instrument control into a unified regression runtime.
- Developed high-throughput system-level stress tests optimized for benchmarking and maximizing networking and storage subsystem performance.
- Defined validation methodologies and high-level regression plans, leading execution across complex system-level product validation cycles.

positions.title: Staff Silicon Validation Engineer
positions.description:
- Led post-silicon characterization and bring-up for complex SoC and network connectivity product lines, successfully validating high-speed IPs including SATA, USB, OTN, ETH, WIS/WAN, and FECs.
- Designed a cross-functional automation flow using SWIG to generate shared libraries, based on unified Direct Programming Interfaces (DPIs), bridging toolchains seamlessly across Software (C/C++), Design Verification (SystemC/SystemVerilog), and Validation (Python) teams.
- Engineered end-to-end testing frameworks and regression structures to automate design-under-test (DUT) configuration and hardware equipment control.
- Optimized system IO performance and executed high-stress reliability testing at the system level.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
- Developed an internal C++ library utilizing advanced logical remapping techniques (tech-mapping) to compact hierarchical netlists at the logic gate level, significantly increasing emulator capacity for complex user designs.
- Created a database management system for RTL signals that provided full visibility into electronic designs at the end of the emulator compilation flow, streamlining hardware debugging of signals and registers.
